rule: A rendered page's class by its site-relative path: the first class, in the order listed, whose paths name it exactly or whose prefixes begin it; any other page is `other`. `run` pages are about the run itself (how the dossier was made, its review, its counts and its size) and fold under the navigation's last entry, About this run; every other page is on the reading path. Raw source pages (sources/* except sources/index.html) are the repository's files, not the dossier's explanation, and are left out before classing.
readers: apps/three-surface-poc/src/polaris-generation/dossier-reader-edition.test.ts (the renderer's About this run fold holds exactly the rendered run pages)
packages/polaris-dossier/src/render.test.ts (the fold of a full render holds exactly the run pages present, in this order)
